title: Combinatorics
description: Counting without listing: how many orders, how many choices, how fast the numbers grow, so fast that their logarithm is the only way to hold them. Unlocks the Quantum Random Number Chip.

puzzle.goal: The number of ways to put n objects in order grows faster than any power of n. For large n its logarithm is very nearly a simple expression. Write it.
puzzle.name: Large-n approximation of the factorial
puzzle.method: ln n! = ln 1 + ln 2 + … + ln n. For large n the sum is close to the integral of ln x from 1 to n.
